note: Nothing on this page has been implemented. Reply in chat with a suggestion ID and option letter (for example, 'S-01: B') to choose a path. Each option lists its trade-offs.

suggestions.question: How should prices appear, if at all?

options.label: No prices on the site
options.pros: Fully compliant with the price rule (S-02 s.2(b)); no stale data risk.

options.label: Prices via Amazon-served link widgets
options.pros: Prices come from Amazon, the permitted source under S-02 s.2(b).
options.cons: Needs a dynamic embed and review of the current terms.

options.label: Prices via PA API
options.cons: Needs API credentials and a policy check of the PA API terms first.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A until a method is verified (advisory only).

suggestions.topic: Hosting for click counter and analytics
suggestions.question: Where should the outbound-click counter and analytics endpoint run?

options.label: Keep static GitHub Pages; use no click counter
options.cons: No click or conversion measurement; FLG-05 and FLG-06 stay open.

options.label: Hosted analytics service plus a self-hosted endpoint on a server you control
options.cons: Needs a server and a cookie and privacy disclosure (S-02 s.3(e)).

options.label: Static site plus privacy-friendly analytics script, no custom endpoint
options.cons: Not self-hosted; still needs a privacy disclosure.

suggestions.recommendation: Decide the five events (FLG-05) first, then choose B or C (advisory only).

suggestions.question: What imagery should appear?

options.label: Original photography you own or license
Amazon-hosted product images
options.cons: Requires review of Program Content rules (S-02 s.6(a)) before use.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A now; move to B when budget allows (advisory only).

suggestions.question: Who is named as the author, and what is the brand?

options.label: Named real author with verifiable bio
options.cons: Requires the person's consent and accurate details.

options.label: Brand name chosen by you
options.cons: Requires a name check before use.

suggestions.recommendation: Option A until a real person or brand is confirmed (advisory only).

suggestions.question: How often should new guides be published?
suggestions.recommendation: Every two weeks, with a review after the first measured cycle (advisory only).

suggestions.question: Which links should the site use?

options.label: Keep the five supplied short links
options.pros: Already in use; no change needed.

options.label: Switch to tested Special Links after the Associates test passes
options.pros: Matches the request and the Special Link rules (S-02 s.2).
options.cons: Needs the test (FLG-04) and intended ASINs (FLG-01).

options.label: Keep the short links and add a Special Link next to each
options.pros: Lets you compare the two tracking reports.

suggestions.recommendation: Option B after the Special Link test and the ASIN confirmation (advisory only).
